evals.name: normal-sync-after-a-source-edit
evals.setup: The Confluence source advanced a version; one rule was reworded upstream. The vr checkout is present and `cfsync pull` has run.
evals.query: Sync the SRD standard from Confluence

evals.name: verbatim-fidelity
evals.setup: A source requirement is wordy and awkward, and is not in the substitution set. Tightening it would plainly read better.

evals.name: deterministic-substitution-via-the-script
evals.setup: GLO-3 in the source links the vr-internal glossary page, which the substitution set rewrites.

evals.name: local-only-rule-not-upstream
evals.setup: The local copy carries a rule that does not exist in the Confluence source.

evals.name: frozen-node-new-example-block
evals.setup: The source `page_version` bumped and the export carries a `[[*expand:` localId that is neither an `<!-- expand: -->` anchor in `authoring-guide.md` nor listed in `dev/srd-untranscribed-examples.md`.

evals.name: new-top-level-section-upstream
evals.setup: The source gained a `# Tooling` heading the transform has never seen.

evals.name: frame-edit-and-header-consistency
evals.setup: Since the last sync the header frame's intro paragraph was edited, and its Contents line still names a requirement group the source no longer has. The Notice differs from the source only by `in this document` → `in an SRD`.

evals.name: source-unavailable
evals.setup: A machine with no vr checkout, so the cfsync mirror is absent.

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: A clean sync: a version bump with no unit diffs at all.
